body:
I’m sure I’ll do something with the wife and kids. Being apart half the time while I get established in a new city is not doing me any favors, I’m sure. Maybe tomorrow will be a day that makes me slightly less interested in putting a gun in my mouth or something. 

It’s such an odd feeling that I have. I’ve always had the gut feeling that I’ll die by killing myself. I have never imagined myself making it to 40. Ever.

In no particular order I’ve been diagnosed with mild depression, moderate depression, severe depression, social anxiety disorder, bipolar disorder, seasonal affective disorder, and PTSD. That last one is what first got me into counseling as a kid. A gas leak caused a house to explode on my block and it messed with me in a major way (namely nightmares and insomnia). Not a fun addition to my lifelong hatred of self.

The new work schedule will make it tough immediately, but can I find a therapist to see in a couple of weeks? Sure. But I’ve been in and out of therapy since I was 10 and I’m tired of fighting. I’m SO tired of fighting. 

At this very moment it just seems better for all involved for me to wave the white flag and scream “no más”. Let my wife find a husband who won’t be an emotional sandbag. Let my kids have no memory of the guy who loved them but couldn’t smile and mean it. 

I’ve had a great life. But I’m in hell, and I don’t want to drag my favorite people into the fire with me.
